2014_spells.immolation.effectSummary: Deal 8d6 fire damage to a target within 90 ft
2014_spells.immolation.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you create a flame that surrounds one creature that you can see within range. It takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; It takes 4d6 fire damage on a failed save, and the spell ends on a successful one. It takes 4d6 fire damage on a failed save, and the spell ends on a successful one; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
